function.name: submit_booking_request
function.description: Submit a caller-confirmed service/booking request to the workshop. Only call this after summarizing the important details and the caller has confirmed they are correct. This is a request, not a confirmed booking: the workshop will contact the caller to confirm a time.

phone.description: Confirmed phone number for the workshop to call back, digits only, e.g. 0701234567, or the caller ID exactly as shown if the caller chose it, e.g. +46701234567. Never template text or placeholders.

registrationNumber.description: Vehicle registration number exactly as read back to and confirmed by the caller, uppercase without spaces, e.g. ABC123. Omit if not relevant or not confirmed.

service.description: TIRE_CHANGE = däckskifte, TIRE_HOTEL = däckhotell, PUNCTURE = punktering, BALANCING = balansering/vibrationer, NEW_TIRES = köpa nya däck, OTHER = annat.

description.description: Short description of what the caller needs, in Swedish, based only on what the caller said.

preferredDate.description: Preferred day as the caller said it; for relative days add the actual date with digits, e.g. 'imorgon, fredag 2 oktober'. Omit if no preference.

preferredTime.description: Exact time the caller wished for, as 24-hour HH:MM, e.g. '14:00' for 'klockan två'. Only a wish, never confirmed. Omit if the caller gave no exact time.

preferredTimeOfDay.description: MORNING = förmiddag, AFTERNOON = eftermiddag, ANY = spelar ingen roll. Omit if not discussed.

tiresStoredAtShop.description: True if the caller's tires are stored at the shop's tire hotel, false if not. Omit if unknown.

tireSize.description: Tire size only if the caller stated it, e.g. '225/45 R18'.

notes.description: Other relevant details the caller gave, e.g. car model. Omit if none.
